canonical.title: Implement Trie II (Prefix Tree with Counts)

narrative.title: The Badge Log Frequency Board
narrative.scenario: A security desk archives every badge word swiped at the gate and must answer tally questions on the fly: how many times was this exact badge word swiped, and how many archived words start with this fragment? Erasing removes one archived occurrence. The desk needs a structure that keeps per-word and per-prefix running tallies.
narrative.inputFormat: A list of operations: ["Trie"], ["insert", word], ["countWordsEqualTo", word], ["countWordsStartingWith", prefix], or ["erase", word].
narrative.outputFormat: Return one entry per count operation; all other operations yield null.
constraints: words and prefixes use lowercase English letters
erase only removes words previously inserted

testCases.explanation: Two inserts tally to 2; one erase drops both counts to 1.
The prefix matches the stored word, but the shorter word itself was never archived.

hintLevels: Level 1: Same walk as a plain trie, but every node now carries two counters — words ending here and words passing through.
Level 2: insert bumps the pass-counter on each new node and the end-counter on the last; erase mirrors exactly that.
Level 3: countWordsEqualTo reads the end counter; countWordsStartingWith reads the pass counter at the prefix node.
